retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: A Python and JS SDK with a CLI, an E2B-compatible SDK, and SSH over a WebSocket proxy with SCP or SFTP file transfer
tooling: the ppio-sandbox Python or JS SDK and CLI, with SSH available on a sandbox template built with an SSH server

limits.value: vCPU bills per core per second at CNY 0.00003 and RAM at CNY 0.000015 per GiB-second; billing stops when the sandbox stops
20 GB of local sandbox storage is free; each account gets 60 GB of free persistent storage, beyond which CNY 0.0005 per GB-hour applies

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
